# Sheet-behaviour fixtures: provenance and licences

`cards/` holds byte-identical copies of the platforms' own material cards. They were
verified on 2026-10-10 against each file's git blob id at the commit named here. They are
test inputs only, copied unmodified, so that the mapping rules are tested on the cards
that really exist.

| Directory | Source | Commit | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cards/pliego/<slug>/stock.json` | [madfam-org/pliego](https://github.com/madfam-org/pliego) `materials/<slug>/stock.json` | `8928b4eef93a65b7040e083fce773ceb90adae2f` (main, kernel 0.2.0) | all 14 stock cards |
| `cards/fashion-cabinet/<slug>/material.json` | madfam-org/fashion-cabinet `materials/<slug>/material.json` | `38115465892b2eb32b9b62ec2dd49f9a570df387` (main) | all 11 fabric cards |
| `cards/yantra4d/bambu-tpu-95a/material.json` | [madfam-org/yantra4d](https://github.com/madfam-org/yantra4d) `materials/bambu-tpu-95a/material.json` | `85476bc6717d8381274806817a32bc9b403e052f` (main) | 1 filament card (identical to `tests/fixtures/aas/bambu-tpu-95a.material.json`) |

Licences:
- the Pliego cards state `CERN-OHL-W-2.0` in their own `provenance.license`;
- the Fashion Cabinet and Yantra4D cards are data from AGPL-3.0 platform repositories (see
  each repo).

None of them is under this repository's Apache-2.0. `cards/fashion-cabinet/manta-cruda`
is the same file this keystone already carries as `tests/fixtures/fc/manta-cruda.material.json`.

Refresh a card from its platform's main when the platform changes it. Then run
`python3 scripts/refresh_sheet_behaviour_golden.py` and review the golden diff. Do not
edit the copies here: a rule that cannot read a real card is the rule's problem.

`thin-prints/` and `laminates/` are written for this repository (Apache-2.0). They
describe test stacks, not cartridges. The TPU 95A constants they rely on cite Bambu Lab's
public TPU 95A HF technical data sheet V1.0
(<https://store.bblcdn.com/58df32731eab4c90a7dac9b12e13ba88.pdf>).

`golden/` is generated by this repository's code from the inputs above, with
`scripts/refresh_sheet_behaviour_golden.py`.
